events.text: Arthur Thorne's office is glass on three sides. He doesn't look up when you knock.
Ms. Vance. You found us; most people drive past twice.
The Harrow manuscript is on your desk. I trust you'll find it... salvageable.

options.text: I read it on the drive up. The second act loses the sister.

events.text: You read the middle. Hardly anyone reads the middle.
Good. Then you already know where the work is.

options.text: Salvageable is a strong word for a book you bought.

events.text: It is. I bought it anyway. That's most of this job.

options.text: Thank you for taking a chance on me.

events.text: Don't thank me yet. Thank me in a year, if we're both still here.
Notes by Friday. In the margins.

then.text: He looks at the empty chair by the window, just for a moment, before he goes back to work.

else.text: He is reading again before you reach the door.
